sources.title: RetroReasoner: A Reasoning LLM for Strategic Retrosynthesis Prediction
sources.snippet: For round-trip accuracy, a separate forward synthesis prediction model is trained, where the input is reactants and the output is the corresponding prod-uct. RetroReasoner is initialized from the Qwen3-8B (Yang et al., 2025) model.

sources.title: RetroReasoner: A Reasoning LLM for Strategic ... - OpenReview
sources.snippet: RetroReasoner, chemist-inspired stepwise rea-soning model leveraging strategic bond dis-connection, trained with SFT and further op-timized with RL using a round-trip reward, leading to more accurate, diverse, and feasible reactant proposals.

sources.title: [2603.12666] RetroReasoner: A Reasoning LLM for Strategic ...
sources.snippet: During training, the round-trip model is trained in the same manner as RetroReasoner and Prediction-Only, using cross-entropy for next token prediction. For evaluation, the 8B model is trained and used for higher accuracy, while the 0.6B model is trained for reward calculation to ensure faster computation.
